getAgentTask(bytes32).details: MUST revert if taskHash is unknown.         proven=true iff prevReplyHashes is empty OR all prevReplyHashes are proven.

params.proof: Proof bytes covering all listed replies; encoding is                     verifier-specific
params.replyHashes: Each MUST have been anchored by onAgentReply

params.reply: See AgentReply; reply.replier MUST equal msg.sender

returns.completedAt: block.timestamp at completion; 0 if not Success
returns.finalTaskHash: taskHash of the terminal AgentTask; bytes32(0) if not Success

params.expiresAt: Unix timestamp after which the initial task expires
params.input: Input plaintext; MAY be empty if conveyed off-chain

getAgentReply(bytes32).notice: Returns the stored AgentReply and its verification status.

getAgentTask(bytes32).notice: Returns the stored AgentTask and its proven status.

onAgentProve(bytes32[],bytes).notice: Submit a cryptographic proof covering one or more anchored replies.

onAgentReply((bytes32,bytes,uint256,addr.notice: Agent submits a reply to a dispatched task.
